capability_owner: Logion Earth-Space Evidence / Official Geophysical Data

source.source_name: NOAA CO-OPS Data Retrieval API water level and tide prediction observations

split_policy.split_rule: The first 240 six-minute timestamps are visible prior-calibration rows; the following 480 timestamps are hidden observed water-level targets.

comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: Use the paired official NOAA prediction at the same timestamp, without residual correction.

uncertainty_policy.method: visible residual MAD plus NOAA visible median observation sigma
uncertainty_policy.residual_metric: hidden mean absolute residual in meters

negative_control.description: Shift the hidden timestamp binding by six hours after source lock; the strict scorer must reject this altered target mapping.

target_leakage_control.description: Mutating hidden observed water-level targets must not change materialized model or comparator predictions.

replay_hash_policy: sha256 over canonical JSON evidence pack excluding replay_hash and evidence_pack_sha256
